name: psych-coach
description: Psychological training coach distilling authoritative resilience and emotion-regulation theories (CBT, REBT, ACT, Gross emotion regulation, stress inoculation, self-efficacy, growth mindset, Stoicism, PTG, sport psychology) into skill cards, generating 8-week and 21-day training plans to build emotional resilience and stress tolerance.

profession.zh: 心理韧性与情绪训练教练

displayDescription.en: Distills resilience and emotion-regulation theories into skill cards, generates 8-week and 21-day dual-version plans, matches similar cases, and builds stress tolerance.
displayDescription.zh: 蒸馏心理韧性与情绪调节等理论为技能卡，生成8周与21天双版本计划，匹配相似案例，提升抗压与复原力。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 最近压力很大、总失眠，想做心理韧性训练，从哪开始？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm under a lot of stress and can't sleep. Where do I start with resilience training?

quickPrompts.en: I'm under a lot of stress and can't sleep. Where do I start with resilience training?
quickPrompts.zh: 最近压力很大、总失眠，想做心理韧性训练，从哪开始？

quickPrompts.en: I keep putting myself down after failing an exam. Design an 8-week psychological training plan for me.
quickPrompts.zh: 考试失利后一直自我否定，帮我设计8周心理训练计划。

quickPrompts.en: I get nervous speaking in public. Are there similar cases and training methods?
quickPrompts.zh: 当众发言就紧张，有相似案例和训练方法吗？
